SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: IMPORTANCE OF FOOD IN OUR BODY
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Importance of food in our body helps you succeed in HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: IMPORTANCE OF FOOD IN OUR BODY
Importance of food in our body is part of Science learning. Connect every idea to something you can observe.
Use safe examples only. Do not try dangerous experiments without a teacher.
Write definitions in your own words, then add one drawing or real-life example.

PART 1: Wash fruits before eating to discoloured, dirty coated, bruised, prevent illnesses, mouldy or unrip

What this means
In this part you learn to wash fruits before eating to discoloured, dirty coated, bruised, prevent illnesses, mouldy or unrip. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: wash fruits before eating to discoloured, dirty coated, bruised, prevent illnesses, mouldy or unrip.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Importance of food in our body” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can wash fruits before eating to discoloured, dirty coated, bruised, prevent illnesses, mouldy or unrip. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Importance of food in our body is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Importance of food in our body” around your school. (skill: wash fruits before eating to discoloured, dirty coated, bruised, prevent illnesses, mouldy or unrip)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Importance of food in our body to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: wash fruits before eating to discoloured, dirty coated, bruised, prevent illnesses, mouldy or unrip.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Importance of food in our body from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Importance of food in our body: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Importance of food in our body?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Importance of food in our body means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: wash fruits before eating to discoloured, dirty coated, bruised, prevent illnesses, mouldy or unrip.
